title: Alfa Nugraha Pradana
text:
I am a PhD Candidate in Infectious & Tropical Diseases Epidemiology at Monash University Indonesia, where my research focuses on malaria and dengue transmission dynamics in the context of Indonesia’s new capital city development.
My background spans statistics, data science, and spatial analysis, with over a decade of professional experience in natural resource management tools at CIFOR-ICRAF. I hold a Master of Science in Statistics and Data Science from IPB University.

title: Alfa Nugraha Pradana
text:
Research Interests

Infectious Disease Epidemiology — malaria and dengue transmission dynamics, community-based surveillance
Spatial Statistics — land use change modelling, geospatial data analysis
Machine Learning — environmental and public health applications
Remote Sensing & GIS — land cover classification, satellite data integration
Natural Resource Management — landscape planning, emission reduction tools

title: Welcome to My Blog
text:
Welcome to my personal blog. Here I plan to share notes and reflections on topics I find interesting, including:

Statistical methods and their applications

title: Projects
text:
Selected tools, dashboards, and course materials I have developed.


Course Materials — Quarto & R Markdown
Tools: R, Quarto, R Markdown
A collection of course materials published via RPubs, covering Computational Statistics, Statistical Data Management, Network Analysis, Spatial Statistics, and Machine Learning.
View on RPubs



Introductory Statistics & Data Analysis — Shiny App
Tools: R, Shiny
An interactive web application introducing fundamental concepts in statistics and data analysis, designed for students in introductory statistics courses at IPB University.
Open app



Statistical Modelling on Geospatial Data — Bookdown
Tools: R, Bookdown
An open online book on statistical modelling applied to geospatial data, covering spatial regression, small area estimation, and related topics.
Read book



Inter-Regional Input-Output Analytical Dashboard
Tools: Python, Streamlit
An analytical dashboard for exploring Table Inter Regional Input Output (IRIO) data, enabling economic sector analysis across Indonesian regions.
Open dashboard



AHP Simulation Dashboard
Tools: R, Shiny
An Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) simulation dashboard for supporting land use decision-making, built as part of landscape planning tools for natural resource management.
Open dashboard



LUMENS — Land Use Planning for Multiple Environmental Services
Tools: Python, R, C++, HTML
Led and contributed to the design, development, testing, and documentation of LUMENS — a modular application suite for sustainable landscape management used across Indonesia and Southeast Asia, developed at ICRAF/CIFOR-ICRAF (2013–2024).
